№ 03Privacy22:30

Your voice stays on this Mac.

  1. i.

    Heard on this Mac.

    What they say and what you say becomes text right here, by default.

  2. ii.

    No recordings.

    Only the transcript and the notes remain, and you can delete them.

  3. iii.

    You decide who gets what.

    The text needed for answers and notes goes only to the service you choose.

No stealth promises: get consent from everyone present before recording or transcribing, and follow the rules of the meeting.

№ 04FAQ23:10

Asked often.

01Will the other side know I’m using it?

It sends nothing into the meeting; it only shows on your screen or phone. If you share your whole screen, prompts on it can be seen, so move the answer to your phone. Whether and how you use it, follow the rules of the meeting.

02Does it work with any meeting app?

Yes. It listens to the sound your Mac plays, so it doesn’t need to know which app that is.

03What if we’re all in one room?

Choose In person. It uses only the microphone and marks the transcript In the room.

04Does it keep recordings?

No. Speech becomes text on your Mac; only the transcript and notes remain.

05I only want notes, no interruptions.

Press Record now. It takes notes quietly during the meeting, and the notes are on the page when it ends.

06When can I use it?

The first beta is running now. Join the waitlist and we’ll write to you as soon as places open.
